name: com.athenrai/offers
title: Athenrai
description: Retailer offers that work for AI shopping agents, read daily from each store's own site, with proof.

tools.name: list_covered_stores
tools.description:
List the online stores Athenrai covers, with coverage status, last observation
        time and offer counts. Call this first to learn which store domains are supported.

tools.name: get_merchant_offers
tools.description:
Find observed offers (promo codes, automatic discounts, free-shipping thresholds,
        bundles) for 1-20 store domains such as "allbirds.com". Each offer carries its
        conditions, the verbatim text seen on the store, its source URL and its freshness.
        Pass next_cursor back as cursor to page. Offers not seen within max_age_seconds
        (default 48 hours) are omitted unless include_stale is true. offer_type is one of:
        code, automatic, discount (no code shown, no minimum stated), threshold (needs a
        minimum spend), shipping, bogo, bundle. Conditions not listed are unknown.

tools.name: find_offers_for_url
tools.description:
Find observed store-level offers for the store that serves a product or page URL,
        e.g. a product page the user is looking at. Whether an offer applies to that
        specific product is not evaluated.

tools.name: get_offer_evidence
tools.description:
Retrieve the captured source evidence for one offer: the exact text, source URL,
        capture time and page hash. Use the snapshot_id from the lookup that returned it.
